crossRefs.note: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!
Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness…
Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our…

translations.web: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
translations.bsb: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
translations.kjv: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
translations.asv: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah: O Jehovah, we beseech thee, send now prosperity.
